intro: Rascally Rodents is a quest in Northshire Valley where Brother Paxton tasks adventurers with recovering stolen books from the local kobolds. Though Paxton initially fears the vermin are devouring his library, retrieving the texts reveals an unsettling mystery behind the creatures' motives.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Those awful kobolds are eating my books! You have to get them back before they devour my whole library.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you rescued my books yet, friend?!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you so much! Here! Take one of these how-to books. I don't need them.
But there are still so many books missing. The kobolds don't seem to be eating them. So, why do they want them?
